description: This file contains the implementation of the ConnectivityProxyActor class, an Akka actor that delegates command and signal messages within a connectivity service. It includes actor creation, message handling, and logging functionalities.

classes.name: ConnectivityProxyActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that delegates command and signal messages received in the connectivity service to appropriate recipients within a cluster, including forwarding RetrieveThings commands to an aggregator actor and other signals to a concierge forwarder.

methods.name: ConnectivityProxyActor
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the actor with a concierge forwarder reference and creating an aggregator proxy actor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props configuration for initializing instances of ConnectivityProxyActor with a specified concierge forwarder.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, routing RetrieveThings messages to the aggregator, forwarding Signal messages to the concierge, and logging unexpected message types.
